skill.name: search-engineer
skill.description: Design, evaluate, and optimize full-text, vector, semantic search, and RAG systems using Elasticsearch, Milvus, and related tools.
skill.summary: Build practical search systems and improve retrieval quality, relevance, and performance.
skill.author: zl2023github

security_audit.summary: All 25 external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. The remote plugin installation URL is a legitimate example, but installing an unchecked archive creates a low-severity supply-chain risk.

remediation.issue: The IK plugin installation example downloads and installs a remote archive without integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the release version and provide a trusted checksum verification step before installation.

low_findings.title: Hardcoded URL
low_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 88 instructs Elasticsearch to download and install a remote plugin archive without checksum verification. The trusted GitHub release context limits impact, but artifact replacement could compromise the host.

content.value_statement: Search teams need reliable guidance across indexing, relevance, semantic retrieval, and evaluation. This skill provides practical workflows and examples for building and improving search systems.
actual_capabilities: Design Elasticsearch mappings, analyzers, shards, replicas, filters, sorting, and pagination strategies.
Configure lexical, vector, and semantic retrieval examples with Elasticsearch, Milvus, and sentence-transformer embeddings.
Calculate ranking metrics including NDCG and mean average precision.
Analyze search logs for zero-result queries, missing clicks, common queries, and latency percentiles.
Plan RAG pipelines covering chunking, embedding selection, vector storage, retrieval, and evaluation.
Improve performance with cache design, query optimization, shard planning, and controlled experiments.
limitations: The examples are introductory references, not complete production deployments.
The skill does not automatically run commands, deploy services, or modify search clusters.
Library imports and APIs may require updates for current package versions.
Relevance recommendations still require representative judgments, traffic data, and domain-specific validation.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Search
use_cases.description: Create mappings, analyzers, ranking logic, and evaluation criteria for a new catalog search experience.
use_cases.target_user: Application developers building their first search service

use_cases.title: Improve Search Relevance
use_cases.description: Diagnose zero-result and low-click queries, then prioritize analyzer, synonym, recall, and ranking changes.
use_cases.target_user: Search engineers maintaining an existing platform

use_cases.title: Design RAG Retrieval
use_cases.description: Select chunking, embeddings, vector storage, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and quality metrics for grounded generation.
use_cases.target_user: Machine learning teams creating RAG applications

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Index
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to create an Elasticsearch index for [data type]. Include field mappings, analyzers, shard choices, and simple validation queries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new searchable dataset

prompt_templates.title: Review Search Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this search schema and query set: [details]. Identify mapping, analyzer, recall, ranking, and pagination improvements with prioritized recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing lexical search service

prompt_templates.title: Design Hybrid Retrieval
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a hybrid retrieval pipeline for [use case] using lexical search, embeddings, filters, reranking, caching, and measurable offline evaluation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture for semantic and keyword retrieval

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Production Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose these search logs and experiment results: [data]. Find quality and latency failures, propose tests, and define rollout and rollback criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced production investigation with controlled deployment planning

output_examples.input: Plan a searchable product catalog with multilingual titles, categories, prices, and availability.
output: Use analyzed text fields for titles and keyword fields for categories and availability.
Store prices as numeric fields for filtering and sorting.
Validate language analyzers with representative queries before indexing the full catalog.

output_examples.input: Find likely causes of a rising zero-result rate after an analyzer change.
output: Compare token output before and after the analyzer release.
Segment failures by language, query length, category, and traffic source.
Replay a judged query set and restore the previous analyzer if recall regressed.

output_examples.input: Outline an evaluation plan for hybrid RAG retrieval.
output: Build a representative query set with passage-level relevance judgments.
Measure recall, NDCG, latency, answer faithfulness, and citation coverage.
Compare lexical, vector, hybrid, and reranked variants before online testing.

best_practices: Use representative relevance judgments and business metrics before changing ranking behavior.
Test mappings, analyzers, and embedding dimensions before loading production-scale data.
Pin dependencies, verify downloaded artifacts, and protect production clusters with authentication and authorization.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize only for offline relevance while ignoring latency, reliability, and user outcomes.
Do not change mappings or analyzers in place without reindexing and rollback planning.
Do not expose an unauthenticated search cluster or run destructive commands against production.

faq.question: Which search engines does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on Elasticsearch and Milvus, with concepts that also apply to Solr, Qdrant, Chroma, and similar systems.

faq.question: Can it build a complete production search service?
faq.answer: It provides architecture, configuration, analysis, and example workflows. Production deployment still requires environment-specific engineering, security, monitoring, and testing.

faq.question: Does it support semantic search and RAG?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers embeddings, vector retrieval, chunking, hybrid search, reranking concepts, and retrieval evaluation.

faq.question: How does it evaluate search quality?
faq.answer: It describes NDCG, mean average precision, click metrics, zero-result analysis, A/B testing, and representative judgment sets.

faq.question: Will it execute the included commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The commands and programs are documentation examples that users must review and run in an appropriate environment.

faq.question: What data should I provide for better recommendations?
faq.answer: Provide schemas, sample documents, representative queries, relevance judgments, latency targets, traffic patterns, and current failure examples.
